<function name="HideGameUI" parent="gui" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Hides the game main menu if it is currently open.

This can only be ran a certain amount of times per second to prevent main menu being completely inaccessible by the player.

Use <page>GM:OnPauseMenuShow</page> to prevent opening the main menu without a one frame flash.
</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
</function>
